description: Implementation of ADPCM decoding functions, including creation, deframing, analysis, decoding, and statistics management for ADPCM audio data.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_create
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new ADPCM decoder instance.

methods.name: adpcm_deframe
methods.description: Removes header from input buffer and prepares it for decoding.

methods.name: adpcm_analyze
methods.description: Analyzes an ADPCM packet, updates decoder state, and checks for sequence and predicted sample consistency.

methods.name: adpcm_decode
methods.description: Decodes ADPCM data into PCM samples, handling endianness.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state to initial conditions.
